name: ESP32 Wake Pin
rules: HIGH at 75% of the supply or above, LOW at 25% or below. In between it could read either way: don't design there.
A high-impedance input draws almost nothing, so an open-collector output reaches it through a pull-up.
GPIO33 is an RTC pin: it can wake the ESP32 from deep sleep.
flavor: Asleep at 10 µA. Awake in a millisecond, when something worth waking for happens.
